predecessors.name: Kingdom of Macedon
predecessors.text: Syria, 'the important government of Syria' given to Laomedon 'in the division of the provinces, after the king's death in 323 BC'; Judea was 'at first governed by Laomedon'

successors.name: Ptolemaic Kingdom
successors.text: Syria, taken by Nicanor for Ptolemy: 'His first occupation of Syria was in 318'

ledger.x: 323: Laomedon of Mytilene is given the government of Syria in the division of the provinces after Alexander's death; 'This he was still allowed to retain on the second partition at Triparadisus in 321 BC.'
323: Laomedon holds Syria under the empire.
318: the satrapy leaves the empire when Ptolemy occupies it.

wars.name: Ptolemy's first occupation of Syria
wars.outcome: Ptolemy's general Nicanor invaded; Laomedon, unable to resist, was captured and sent to Egypt, then escaped to join Alcetas in Pisidia.

certainty.note: A satrapy's limits are administrative and approximate; no page opened draws them.
